title: Artinian local algebras with finite H_1 of the residue field are filtered colimits of flat essentially finite type ones
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$ and let $(\Lambda,\mathfrak m,K)$ be an Artinian local $k$-algebra (a commutative $k$-algebra which is a local ring, with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and residue field $K=\Lambda/\mathfrak m$, in which every descending chain of ideals is eventually constant). Assume that $H_1(L_{K/k})$, the first homology of the naive cotangent complex of the $k$-algebra $K$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], is a finite dimensional $K$-vector space. Then there is a set $\mathcal A$ of $k$-subalgebras $A\subseteq\Lambda$, directed under inclusion (any two members are contained in a third) and with union $\Lambda$, such that every $A\in\mathcal A$ is an Artinian local ring, the inclusion $A\to\Lambda$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], $\mathfrak m_A\Lambda=\mathfrak m$ (the maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_A$ of $A$ generates the ideal $\mathfrak m$ of $\Lambda$), and $A$ is essentially of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra] (isomorphic as a $k$-algebra to a localization $W^{-1}B$ of a finitely generated $k$-algebra $B$ at a multiplicative subset $W\subseteq B$). In particular $\Lambda$ is the filtered colimit of the Artinian local $k$-algebras $A\in\mathcal A$, with flat maps $A\to\Lambda$, $\mathfrak m_A\Lambda=\mathfrak m$, and $A$ essentially of finite type over $k$.

proof.text: Apply the adjusted coefficient presentation theorem to obtain σ,t,c with the residue-section, maximal-ideal generation, ring-containment and generation clauses.
Apply the coefficient descent theorem to obtain c0 and the Artinian local, flat, maximal-ideal and essential finite type properties of every C_(c0∪s). Let A(s)=C_(c0∪s) and S be its range.

IntermediateField.adjoin is monotone, hence A is monotone in the finite coefficient set s. The union s∪s′ bounds both sets and proves directedness. In the supremum of the A(s), every t-generator lies in A(empty), and σ(b) lies in A({b}) for each residue coefficient b. The generation clause of the presentation theorem makes this supremum top. Mathlib Subalgebra.coe_iSup_of_directed therefore gives coverage of Λ by S.

For a compatible family f on S, Subalgebra.iSupLift gives a homomorphism on the top subalgebra, since the supremum of S is top by coverage. Compose with Subalgebra.topEquiv.symm to obtain Λ→ₐ[k]T. The iSupLift_mk theorem proves every restriction equals f. For uniqueness, put x in a member B of S by coverage and evaluate both restriction equalities on the subtype element (x,hx); the homomorphisms agree at x.

split_report.summary: Proof written in 12 steps following the Stacks proof of 07FG: setup (m nilpotent and finitely generated), the claim (existence of a section sigma and a finitely generated F with i(k) in Psi_sigma(F[x])) by induction on n with base case, lifts of sigma' and tau' along nilpotent kernels (new node lem-weil-pbc-field-char-p-nilpotent-lifting: Algebra 0320 (3) for K/F_p, F_p perfect, plus the iteration from square-zero to nilpotent), the derivation theta and the effect of sigma -> sigma + D (written out), the Jacobi-Zariski sequence for F_p in k in K (existing 00S2 node; only exactness at K otimes Omega_{k/F_p} is used, so H_1(L_{K/F_p}) = 0 is not needed) giving J_0, the choice of D and f_j, the end of the induction, surjectivity of Psi_sigma and finite generation of its kernel (Hilbert basis, existing leaf), flatness and injectivity of A_F -> Lambda via K otimes_F B_F = Lambda (existing leaves 00HI-type base change, ideal contraction, quotient base change), A_F Artinian local with m_A Lambda = m and residue field F, essentially of finite type via 07DT (3) (new node lem-weil-pbc-artinian-local-essentially-finite-type-residue) and the new definition node def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra (Mathlib leaf Algebra.EssFiniteType), and the directed union. Statement sharpened to the directed-union form that Stacks' proof gives and its first sentence states (the citer uses exactly this); the inline definition of essentially of finite type now cites the new definition node; def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime removed from stmt_deps (it defines localization at a prime only).

lean.statement: theorem exists_directed_artinian_flat_subalgebras (k : Type u) [Field k] (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ] [IsArtinianRing Λ] [IsLocalRing Λ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p) (hH : Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ) (H1Cotangent k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ))) : ∃ S : Set (Subalgebra k Λ), DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) S ∧ (∀ x : Λ, ∃ A ∈ S, x ∈ A) ∧ (∀ A ∈ S, ∃ hA : IsLocalRing A, IsArtinianRing A ∧ RingHom.Flat A.val.toRingHom ∧ Ideal.map A.val.toRingHom (@IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A _ hA) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Λ ∧ EssFiniteType k A) ∧ (∀ (T : Type (max u v w)) [CommRing T] [Algebra k T] (f : ∀ A : S, A.1 →ₐ[k] T), (∀ (A B : S) (h : A.1 ≤ B.1), (f B).comp (Subalgebra.inclusion h) = f A) → ∃! g : Λ →ₐ[k] T, ∀ A : S, g.comp A.1.val = f A)
